# Kingdom of Christ Ministries (KCM Church)

> Official website and Knowledge Base for Kingdom of Christ Ministries (KCM), a Christ-centred church community and registered society in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

## Organization Summary
- **Organization Name**: Kingdom of Christ Ministries
- **Common Names**: KCM Church, KCM Ministries, KCM
- **Founder & Senior Pastor**: Bishop Kurra Kristhu Raju
- **Founding Year**: 2000
- **Headquarters**: 15-201, Vivekananda Nagar, Srinivas Nagar, Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, Telangana 500055, India
- **Coordinates**: 17.5186° N, 78.4487° E
- **Website**: https://kcmchurch.vercel.app
- **Official Contact Numbers**: +91 97040 90069, +91 96409 43777, +91 73964 33856
- **Email**: kingofchristministries23@gmail.com
- **Official YouTube**: https://www.youtube.com/@kcmchurchshapur7107

## Church Sanctuaries & Branches (Hyderabad)
1. **Shapur Nagar Main Sanctuary**:
   - Address: 15-201, Vivekananda Nagar, Srinivas Nagar, Jeedimetla, Hyderabad 500055
   - Services: Sunday Evening Worship (6:00 PM – 9:00 PM), Friday Prayer Fellowship (6:00 PM – 8:30 PM)
2. **Subhash Nagar Branch**:
   - Address: Subhash Nagar, Jeedimetla, LP 119, Hyderabad 500055
   - Services: Sunday Morning Watch Tower Prayer (5:45 AM – 8:30 AM), Sunday Second Worship (8:30 AM – 10:30 AM), Thursday Oil Anointing Service (6:30 PM – 8:30 PM)
3. **Bahadurpally Branch**:
   - Address: Bahadurpally Main Road, Near Tech Mahindra / Gandimaisamma, Hyderabad 500043
   - Services: Sunday Afternoon Worship Service (11:00 AM – 1:00 PM), 2nd Tuesday Monthly Intercession

## Leadership & Mission
- **Senior Pastor**: Bishop Kurra Kristhu Raju
- **Mission**: Proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ, nurturing believers through biblical discipleship, fervent intercessory prayer, inspiring worship, and compassionate community service.

## Ministries
- Worship & Music Ministry
- Children's Sunday School
- Youth Fellowship & Conferences
- Women's Fellowship & Intercession
- Men's Ministry
- Fasting & Deliverance Prayers

## Humanitarian & Social Work (KCM Society NGO)
- **Bethany Ashramam Outreach**: Regular support, supplies, and compassionate care for elderly and leprosy-affected residents.
- **Gandhi Hospital Medical Assistance**: Nutritious food distribution, emergency support, and spiritual comfort for hospital patients and caretakers.
- **Education & Child Support**: Educational materials, stationery, and assistance for underprivileged children.
- **Disaster Relief & Food Drives**: Essential rations and clothing drives across vulnerable communities in Hyderabad and Telangana.
